network.description: Card network where the transaction took place. AMEX, VISA, MASTERCARD, MAESTRO, or INTERLINK.

institution_id.description: The institution that activity occurred on. For Mastercard: ICA (Interbank Card Association). For Maestro: institution ID. For Visa: lowest level SRE (Settlement Reporting Entity).

settlement_institution_id.description: The institution responsible for settlement. For Mastercard: same as `institution_id`. For Maestro: billing ICA. For Visa: Funds Transfer SRE (FTSRE).

report_date.description: Date that the network total record applies to. YYYY-MM-DD format.

cycle.description: The clearing cycle that the network total record applies to. Mastercard only.

is_complete.description: Indicates that all settlement records related to this Network Total are available in the details endpoint.

gross_settlement.description: Total settlement amount excluding interchange, in currency's smallest unit.

interchange_fees.description: Interchange amount, in currency's smallest unit.

visa_charges.description: Charges specific to Visa/Interlink, in currency's smallest unit.

net_settlement.description: `gross_settlement` net of `interchange_fees` and `visa_charges` (if applicable), in currency's smallest unit.

created.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for when the record was created. UTC time zone.

updated.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for when the record was last updated. UTC time zone.
